item.title: Jordan Airstrikes On Syria Kill Seven Civilians, Syrian State Media Says
item.description: The strikes were in retaliation for an attack on a church in southern Jordan on Friday, the Jordan military said. They threatened to damage relations between the two neighbors.

item.title: Two Candidates, Two Israels, One Nation in the Balance
item.description: As Israel votes, hard-right nationalism competes with the country’s founding ideals. The outcome could shape Israel’s identity for years.
